relationships.subject: angiogenesis
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicated that the expression of mutant Pik3ca in ECs is not sufficient for the acquisition of a malformed vascular phenotype and that active angiogenesis is required for PI3K‐driven vascular malformations to occur.

key_findings: Active angiogenesis is required for Pik3ca H1047R endothelial mutations to produce vascular malformations in the postnatal mouse retina.
The AKT inhibitor miransertib prevented and caused regression of PI3K-driven malformations and reduced viability of patient-derived mutant endothelial cells.
